item.title: Re: SCP Idea, needs greenlight
item.content:encoded:
Hey there MemesAtLarge, I'll be critting your idea today!
This is going to be a relatively brief crit, so here goes:

Your pitch, while intriguing, unfortunately comes across as just another version of those trippy shapes. They both incorporate entities from a higher-dimensional plane, they both made contact with people for knowledge, and they both appear in the form of shapes. In my opinion, your idea is just too similar to succeed on the Site without being pegged as a clone of SCP-2634. I'd recommend either heavily reworking or potentially even scrapping this idea, due to the similarities and therefore immense difficulty in successfully executing this idea on the mainsite.

I also recommend two more things:
1. Check out the Guide Hub for some great essays on ideation and story-ing!
2. Contact someone from the Butterfly Squad for some alternative opinions from experienced reviewers!

Anyway, thanks for reading, and I hope this helps!

item.title: SCP Idea, needs greenlight
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: This new SCP is a Euclid 5th dimensional creature that can only be seen in the 3rd dimension due to human limitations. It is a 1.8 meter tall floating polyhedron figure that vibrates faster then the human eye can see, making it look distorted (I have a drawing and a sandbox, reply and ask for this if you would like.) There is no way yet found to figure out the actual shape of this SCP, but is expected to be larger then seen. It's voice is heard from all directions within a 20 foot radius, directly speaking into the mind of the listener, not from any position.

Central Narrative: SCP was found at a crash landing like a meteorite in a redacted city in Malaysia. Inside men at the Malaysian Special Branch were alerted and sent in a MTF. In a interview( see sandbox), the interviewer was told that the SCP was on this planet to relay information about the 3rd detention as part of a "science experiment".

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP acts as a godlike creature that can absorb knowledge of people it communicates to. SCP also grows in size when matter is absorbed by it, depending on the mass of the object. SCP has the ability to lure in people to come in contact with it, seemingly unwillingly, which in turns gets absorbed by SCP to gain mass. (Interview). The SCP seems to be willing to stay in the containment, in fear of doing harm to the planet and its people, "I intend to cause no destruction, but my nature on this plane of existence is dangerous." (SCP).

Additional Notes: This is my first SCP and I was hoping that a veteran can help me make this an official SCP. Thank you guys so much for taking your time to read this!
